s: puM, (purasyAriH .) SrIkfzRaH । asya vyutpattiryaTA, -- “muraH kleSe ca santApe karmmaBoge ca karmmiRAm । dEtyaBede'pyaristezAM murAristena kIrttitaH ॥” iti brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe 110 aDyAyaH ॥ asya svarUpaM yaTA, -- SrInArada uvAca । “ko'sO murArirdevarze ! devo yakzo nu kiM naraH । dEtyo vA rAkzaso vApi pArTivo vA taducyatAm ॥” pulastya uvAva । “yo'sO rajaHsattvamAyAguRavAMSca tamomayaH । nirgaRaH sarvvago vyApI murArirmmaDusUdanaH ॥” SrInArada uvAca । “yo'sO mura iti KyAtaH kasya puttraSca gIyate । kaTaYca nihataH saMKye vizRunA tadvadasva me ॥” pulastya uvAca । “SrUyatAM kaTayizyAmi murAsuranivarhaRam । vicitramidamAKyAnaM puRyaM pApapraRASanam ॥ kaSyapasyOrasaH puttro muro nAma mahAbalaH । sa dadarSa raRe SamBuM ditiputtro'surottamaH ॥ tataH sa maraRAd BItastaptvA varzagaRAn bahUn । ArADayAmAsa viBuM brahmARamaparAjitam ॥ tato'sya tuzwo varadaH prAha vatsa ! varaM vfRu । sa ca vavre tadA dEtyo varamenaM pitAmahAt ॥ yaM yaM karatalenAhaM spfSeyaM samare viBo ! । sa sa madDastasaMspfzwastvamaro'pi mriyatvaja ! ॥ bAQamuktvA sa BagavAn brahmA lokapitAmahaH । tato'ByagAnmahAtejA muraH suragiriM balI । jagAma DarmmarAjAnaM vijetuM daRqapARinam ॥” mura uvAca । “yama ! prajAsaMyamanAnnivfttiM karttumarhasi । no cettavAdya CittvAhaM mUrdDvAnaM pAtaye Buvi ॥ tamAha DarmmarAqvAkyaM yadi mAM saMyamedBavAn । gopitAsi purA satyaM karizye vacanaM tava ॥ murastamAha BavataH kaH saMyantA vadasva mAm । ahaM taYca parAjitya vArayAmi na saMSayaH ॥ yamastaM prAha mAM vizRurdevaScakragadADaraH । SvetadbIpanivAsI yaH sa mAM saMyamate'vyayaH ॥ ityeva mukto vattanaM dugDAbDimagamanmuraH ॥ tamAgataM prAha mune ! maDuGnaH prApto'si kenAsura ! kAraRena । sa prAha yudDaM saha vE tvayAdya taM prAha BUyaH suraSatruhantA ॥ yadIha mAM yodDumupAgato'si tat kampate te hfdayaM kimarTam । jvarAturasyeva muhurmuhurvvE tannEva yotsye saha kAtareRa ॥ ityevamukto maDusUdanena murastadA sve hfdaye svahastam । kaTaM nu kampeti muhustadoktvA nipAtayAmAsa vipannabudDiH ॥ hariSca cakraM mfdulAGavena mumoca tattasya Sirastu SatroH । cicCeda devAstu gatavyaTABavan devaM praSaMsanti ca padmanABam । itaH prasidDaM samupAjagAma murArirityeva harirmahAtmA ॥” iti vAmane 57 । 58 aDyAyO ॥ * ॥ anarGarAGavagranTakarttA । yaTA । ‘asti mOdgalyagotrasamudBUtasya mahAkaverBawwaSrIvardDamAnAtmajasya tantumatIhfdayanandanasya murArinAmaDeyasya kaveH kftiranarGarAGavaM nAma nAwakaM tatprayuYjAnAH sAmAjikAnupAsmahe .’ iti tatkftanAwakagadyam ॥
m: मुरारि m. ‘enemy of Mura’, N. of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu, Kāv.; Pur.; Kathās.
N. of the author of the Murāri-nāṭaka or Anargha-rāghava
of a Sch. on the Kātantra grammar and other authors &c. (also with पाठक, भट्ट, मिश्र &c.), Cat.
a: मुरारि — Author of the Anargha-rāghava mentioned by the poet Ratnākara (who flourished in the 9th century) in Haravijaya 38. 67. He must, therefore be placed before the 9th century.

k.v: शङ्खो लक्ष्मीपतेः पाञ्चजन्यश्चक्रं सुदर्शनम्. कौमोदकी गदा खड्गो नन्दकः कौस्तुभो मणिः। चापः शार्ङ्गंमुरारेस्तु श्रीवत्सो लाञ्छनं स्मृतम्. अश्वाश्च शैव्यसुग्रीवमेघपुष्पबलाहकाः। सारथिर्दारुको मन्त्री ह्युद्धवश्चानुजो गदः॥

m: मुरारि—श्री-पति m. (with सावभौम) N. of an author, Cat.
मुरारि—गुप्त m. N. of a disciple of Caitanya, Cat.
मुरारि—मिश्रीय n. N. of wk.
मुरारि—नाटक n. Murāri's drama i.e. Anargha-rāghava (-व्याख्या, f. and -व्याख्या-पूर्ण-सरस्वती f. N. of Comms. on it)
मुरारि—नाटक—व्याख्या f. N. of Comm. on Murāri's drama
मुरारि—नाटक—व्याख्या-पूर्ण-सरस्वती f. N. of Comm. on Murāri's drama

मुर्भिणी f. a chafing-dish, fire-pan, L.

मुर्छ् or मूर्छ् cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. vii, 32) मूर्छति (pf. मुमूर्छ, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; aor. अमूर्छीत् Gr.; fut. मूर्छिता, मूर्छिष्यति, ib.; ind.p., मूर्त्वा, ib.), to become solid, thicken, congeal, assume shape or substance or consistency, expand, increase, grow, become or be vehement or intense or strong, AV. &c. &c.; to fill, pervade, penetrate, spread over, Kālid.; to have power or take effect upon (loc.), ib.; to grow stiff or rigid, faint, swoon, become senseless or stupid or unconscious, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to deafen, Caurap.; to cause to sound aloud, MBh. : Caus. मूर्छयति (mc. also ˚ते), to cause to thicken or coagulate (milk), Kauś.; to cause to settle into a fixed or solid form, shape, AitUp.; to strengthen, rouse, excite, MBh.; R.; to cause to sound loudly, play (a musical instrument), BhP.
a: मुर्छ् — {c1c} P. (मूर्छति, मूर्छित or मूर्तं; the word is written as मूर्छ् or मूर्च्छ्) 1 To settle into a solid form, coagulate, congeal. --2 To faint, swoon, faint away; lose consciousness, become senseless; पतत्युद्याति मूर्च्छत्यपि Gīt. 4; क्रीडानिर्जितविश्वमूर्च्छितजनाघातेन किं पौरुषं Gīt. 3; Bk. 15. 55. --3 To grow, increase, become strong or powerful; मुमूर्च्छ सहजं तेजो हविषेव हविर्भुजः R. 10. 79; मुमूर्च्छ सख्यं रामस्य 12. 57; मूर्च्छंत्यमी विकाराः प्रायेणैश्वर्यमत्तेषु Ś. 5. 18; Ki. 16. 8, 59. --4 To gather strength, thicken, become dense, prevail; तमसां निशि मूर्च्छतां V. 3. 7. --5 To take effect on; छाया न मूर्च्छति मलोपहतप्रसादे शुदे तु दर्पणतले सुलभावकाशा Ś. 7. 32; हर्म्येषु मूर्छंति न चंद्रपादाः R. 16. 18 ‘are not reflected’ &c. (b) To prevail against, have power against; न पादपोन्मूलनशक्ति रंहः शिलोच्चये मूर्छति मारुतस्य R. 2. 34. --6 To fill, pervade, penetrate, spread over; Ku. 6. 59; R. 6. 9. --7 To be a match for. --8 To be frequent. --9 To cause to sound loudly. --Caus. (मूर्छयति-ते) 1 To stupefy, cause to faint; म्लेच्छान्मूर्छयते Gīt. 1. --2 To strengthen, increase. --3 To excite, stir up. --4 To cause to sound loudly, play on (as a musical instrument).
